It’s hard to pinpoint when things started to unravel, but I’d say it’s been about seven months now that this dark cloud has been hanging over me. I used to love playing golf, my escape from the courtroom, but now the thought of it just feels… empty. I spend most nights tossing and turning, waking up constantly, and when I do finally drift off, I'm often up again within a few hours. Lately, I've been so restless, can't seem to sit still; I pace around the house or find myself picking at my cuticles without even realizing it. The tears come easily now, far too easily for a man my age.

Then there are these other… experiences, that have been going on for about six months. I keep smelling this foul, rotten odor, like something is decaying, even when there's nothing there. It's truly unsettling. And my body… I’m convinced something is terribly wrong with my insides, that my organs are deteriorating. I've seen doctors, but they all say I'm fine. Sometimes my thoughts just jump around, you know? One minute I’m thinking about a case, and the next I’m wondering about the color of the sky, with no real connection. It’s making it impossible to focus on my work, which, as a lawyer, is a serious problem. My ex-wife even mentioned how disjointed I sound sometimes. I just want to feel like myself again.

I'll just start crying for no reason, and I can't seem to stop. Nothing interests me anymore. My golf clubs are gathering dust, and I used to love playing. At night, I'm constantly waking up, tossing and turning, and sometimes I just pace the house, wringing my hands, feeling this incredible restlessness.

But it's not just the low mood. For the past six months, things have gotten really strange. I'm convinced something's terribly wrong with my insides—I've seen specialists, but they say I'm fine. And the smells... I keep smelling this awful, rotting odor, even when there's nothing there. It's truly disturbing. When I try to explain it, my thoughts just jump all over the place. I know I'm not making sense, but my mind races from one idea to the next.

What's really difficult is that these dark, sad feelings, and all the bizarre things happening in my head, they've been going on at the same time. The strange smells and the belief about my body, those have actually stuck around even during the few times I've felt a tiny bit better and less tearful. But the depression, the sadness and the lack of interest, that's what's dominated almost the entire time I've been feeling ill."

I'll start talking about the quiet decay and then suddenly I'm rambling about the dust motes in the sunlight by the history section, and it all just drifts away. It’s hard to focus. Sometimes, I just sit there, unmoving, for hours, completely disconnected from everything. Other times, though, I can't sit still at all. My hands are constantly fiddling, picking at my cuticles, pacing the small space of my apartment. It’s worse at night; the nightmares are relentless, always about the world dissolving, leaving me adrift. I feel so numb most of the time, like my feelings are wrapped in cotton wool. It's truly made it impossible to do my job properly; I just can't connect with anything or anyone.
